entries.d39b070862fd0e4d: This business is centered on "Norikae Annai", route search and fare calculation software for railways and other transport. For individuals, it sells PC products and provides version-upgrade services for them. For corporations, in addition to selling corporate products, it embeds the software in the travel expense settlement portion of corporate information systems, provides it for the web services of other companies and organizations, and provides solutions for transport operators. On the internet and mobile, it also provides "Norikae Annai" and restaurant information, and its revenue sources include paid mobile services, sales of advertising space, planning, arranging and selling travel, and sales of mobile tickets. Consolidated subsidiary Compass TV Co., Ltd. sells advertising space on "Norikae Annai", E-Tour Co., Ltd. arranges travel and related services, and J MaaS Co., Ltd. handles services for arranging, selling and providing means of transport using ICT. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥2,343 million.
entries.d3bf58b5f8b90181: This business sells and maintains hardware and operates drone schools, among other activities. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥176 million.
entries.df7e94920fa1ee5b: This business undertakes contract software development and related work. In addition to the company, consolidated subsidiaries Zestpro Co., Ltd., J Frontier Co., Ltd. and Ruoerdan (Shanghai) Software Development Co., Ltd. plan, design, develop and maintain systems and software, and also handle development outsourced for the company's products. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥301 million.
